tools.name: search_leads
tools.description: Search the businesses this LeadsIt account has already found, best sales score first, with their emails, phones, websites and social profiles. Put every filter in one call; the result has the total that match. Use offset to page. format "csv" returns a CSV file of up to 5,000 rows for a spreadsheet.

tools.name: create_lead_search
tools.description: Start a live search for one business type in one city: LeadsIt searches public business listings live, then reads each business website for emails, phones and social profiles. Spends 1 search credit, so check search_leads first. Takes 1 to 4 minutes; set waitSeconds (up to 50) to wait here, or poll

tools.name: get_search_status
tools.description: Status and lead count of a search. waitSeconds (up to 50) waits until it finishes. Free.

tools.name: list_searches
tools.description: The searches this account ran, newest first, with their status and number of leads. Free.

tools.name: analyze_company_website
tools.description: Read a company website and suggest who it sells to: the business type and the place to search next with create_lead_search. Accounts with a pack or plan. Free.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: The account plan, search credits, AI actions and how many leads it holds. Free.
